question_text: Which of the following is a complete administration utility for SQL Server?
correct_answer: SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)

question_text: Users are NOT allowed to directly update information in which of the following?
option4: System tables, system stored procedures, and catalog views
correct_answer: System tables, system stored procedures, and catalog views

question_text: Which API includes complete functionality for administering SQL Server in applications?
correct_answer: SQL Server Management Objects (SQL-SMO)

question_text: Which of these is required information to create a user-defined database?
option1: Only the name of the database
option2: Name, owner, size, and files and filegroups of the database
correct_answer: Name, owner, size, and files and filegroups of the database

question_text: The purpose of user-defined databases is to store ______.
correct_answer: user data

question_text: In the CREATE DATABASE syntax, which clause indicates the disk files used to store the database log?
correct_answer: LOG ON

question_text: In the CREATE DATABASE syntax, the ON clause indicates ______.
option1: the disk files used to store the log
option2: the disk files used to store the data sections of the database
correct_answer: the disk files used to store the data sections of the database

question_text: What does the COLLATE clause define in CREATE DATABASE?
option1: The default collation (rules for comparing and sorting character data) for the database
option2: The size of the log file
correct_answer: The default collation (rules for comparing and sorting character data) for the database

question_text: A collation defines rules for ______.
option3: comparing and sorting character data based on a particular language and locale
correct_answer: comparing and sorting character data based on a particular language and locale

question_text: Which is the correct syntax to create a database with a primary file and log file?
option1: CREATE DATABASE [Customer_DB] ON PRIMARY (NAME='Customer_DB', FILENAME='...Customer_DB.mdf') LOG ON (...)
correct_answer: CREATE DATABASE [Customer_DB] ON PRIMARY (NAME='Customer_DB', FILENAME='...Customer_DB.mdf') LOG ON (...)

question_text: Which file extension is recommended for the primary database file?
correct_answer: .mdf

question_text: Which file extension is recommended for the transaction log file?
correct_answer: .ldf

question_text: Which file extension is recommended for secondary data files?
correct_answer: .ndf

question_text: MDF stands for ______.
correct_answer: Master Database File

question_text: Does SQL Server enforce the .mdf, .ndf, and .ldf file name extensions?
option1: No, they are only recommended to help identify the use of the file
option4: Only for databases created using SSMS
correct_answer: No, they are only recommended to help identify the use of the file

question_text: Which statement is used to modify an existing database?
correct_answer: ALTER DATABASE

question_text: Which is the correct statement to rename the database Customer_DB to CUST_DB?
option2: ALTER DATABASE Customer_DB MODIFY NAME = CUST_DB
option3: UPDATE DATABASE Customer_DB SET NAME = CUST_DB
correct_answer: ALTER DATABASE Customer_DB MODIFY NAME = CUST_DB

question_text: Which of the following can be performed using ALTER DATABASE?
option4: Add or modify files and filegroups, set database options, rename, and change collation
correct_answer: Add or modify files and filegroups, set database options, rename, and change collation

question_text: Which system stored procedure is used to change the ownership of a database?
correct_answer: sp_changedbowner

question_text: After sp_changedbowner is executed, the new owner is known as the ______ user inside the database.
correct_answer: dbo

question_text: The ownership of which of these databases CANNOT be changed?
option1: master, model, and tempdb system databases
correct_answer: master, model, and tempdb system databases

question_text: Which of these is NOT a database option type supported by SQL Server 2019?
correct_answer: Network options

question_text: Which database option type controls recovery models of a database?
correct_answer: Recovery options

question_text: Which database option type controls the online/offline state and user connectivity?
correct_answer: State options

question_text: Database options are set using which clause of the ALTER DATABASE statement?
correct_answer: SET

question_text: Server-wide settings in SQL Server are set using ______.
option4: the sp_configure system stored procedure or SSMS
correct_answer: the sp_configure system stored procedure or SSMS

question_text: What does setting the AUTO_SHRINK option to ON do?
option1: Shrinks the database that has free space
correct_answer: Shrinks the database that has free space

question_text: In SQL Server, data files are subdivided into ______ for the sake of performance.
correct_answer: filegroups

question_text: Where are all system tables placed?
correct_answer: Inside the primary filegroup

question_text: What is the maximum number of filegroups that can be created for each database?
Which statement about filegroups is correct?
option1: Transaction log files must belong to the primary filegroup
option2: Filegroups can contain only data files; transaction log files cannot belong to a filegroup
option3: Filegroups can contain only log files
option4: A filegroup can contain only one file
correct_answer: Filegroups can contain only data files; transaction log files cannot belong to a filegroup

question_text: Which statement about a file and filegroups is correct?
option1: A file cannot be a member of more than one filegroup at the same time
option2: A file can belong to any number of filegroups
option3: A file can belong to a maximum of two filegroups
option4: A log file can belong to a user-defined filegroup
correct_answer: A file cannot be a member of more than one filegroup at the same time

question_text: Can a file be moved to a different filegroup after it has been added to the database?
option3: Yes, but only for log files
option4: No, files cannot be moved to a different filegroup once added
correct_answer: No, files cannot be moved to a different filegroup once added

question_text: Which statement adds a filegroup named FG_ReadOnly to the existing database CUST_DB?
option2: ALTER DATABASE CUST_DB CREATE FILEGROUP FG_ReadOnly
option3: ALTER DATABASE CUST_DB ADD FILEGROUP FG_ReadOnly
option4: UPDATE DATABASE CUST_DB ADD FILEGROUP FG_ReadOnly
correct_answer: ALTER DATABASE CUST_DB ADD FILEGROUP FG_ReadOnly

question_text: What is required to make a filegroup the default filegroup?
option2: It must contain the transaction log
option3: It must contain at least one file
correct_answer: It must contain at least one file

question_text: Which statement makes the filegroup FG_ReadOnly the default filegroup?
option1: ALTER DATABASE CUST_DB MODIFY FILEGROUP FG_ReadOnly DEFAULT
option2: ALTER DATABASE CUST_DB SET DEFAULT FILEGROUP FG_ReadOnly
correct_answer: ALTER DATABASE CUST_DB MODIFY FILEGROUP FG_ReadOnly DEFAULT

question_text: What does the transaction log in SQL Server record?
option2: All transactions and the database modifications made by each transaction
correct_answer: All transactions and the database modifications made by each transaction

question_text: Which of the following is a clause used to add a transaction log file to an existing database?
correct_answer: ADD LOG FILE

question_text: Which Transact-SQL statement is used to delete a database?
correct_answer: DROP DATABASE

question_text: What should be done before dropping a database?
option1: The log file should be deleted
option2: A full backup of the database should be taken
option4: A snapshot should be set as default
correct_answer: A full backup of the database should be taken

question_text: A deleted database can be re-created only by ______.
correct_answer: restoring a backup

question_text: Which of these statements about a database snapshot is true?
option1: It provides a read-write copy of the database
option2: It can be created only using SSMS
option3: It can be backed up like a normal database
option4: It provides a read-only, static view of a SQL Server database
correct_answer: It provides a read-only, static view of a SQL Server database

question_text: How can a database snapshot be created?
option4: Using Transact-SQL only; SSMS does not support it
correct_answer: Using Transact-SQL only; SSMS does not support it

question_text: Which of these is an advantage of database snapshots?
option1: Snapshot backups can be created easily
option2: New users can be granted access to snapshot data
option3: Snapshots can be located on any server
option4: When queried, there is no deterioration of server performance
correct_answer: When queried, there is no deterioration of server performance

question_text: Which of these is a disadvantage of database snapshots?
option2: A snapshot backup cannot be created
option3: They take a long time to create
correct_answer: A snapshot backup cannot be created

question_text: Which of these is a disadvantage of database snapshots?
option1: A snapshot must exist on the same database server as the source database
correct_answer: A snapshot must exist on the same database server as the source database

question_text: Which clause is used in CREATE DATABASE to create a database snapshot?
correct_answer: AS SNAPSHOT OF

question_text: In a database snapshot, if a user makes a mistake in the source database, the source database can be ______.
option2: reverted to the state when the snapshot was created
correct_answer: reverted to the state when the snapshot was created

question_text: In the New Database dialog box in SSMS, how can the database collation be changed?
option3: Select the Options page and choose a collation from the list
correct_answer: Select the Options page and choose a collation from the list

question_text: In SSMS, where can a new filegroup be added while creating a database?
correct_answer: The Filegroups page
